cohort: Neonates (n=194) admitted to the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) at Lira Regional Referral Hospital (LRRH) in northern Uganda between September 2022 and February 2023.
finding: The prevalence of neonatal sepsis among neonates admitted to the NICU of LRRH was 41.2%, with age 1-3 days, male sex, birth weight <2500g, and Apgar score 1-4 at birth being significant associated factors.
birth_weight: measured, with <2500g identified as a significant factor
